# Documentation Authority and Release Boundary

## Purpose

The manual will explain scientific calculations from theory and assumptions
through typed inputs, units, coordinate and time conventions, algorithms,
implementation symbols, tests, uncertainty, limitations, user surfaces, and
artifacts. UpstreamDrift source and evidence remain authoritative; the manual
cannot approve a calculation that its owning source, evidence, or human review
has not approved.

## Canonical Source

Only QMD under `manuals/upstreamdrift` is editable manual source. Existing user
guides, ADRs, research articles, LaTeX projects, and generated publications are
separate governed products. They can supply reviewed references, but none is a
second mutable source for this manual.

Generated LaTeX, PDF, DOCX, and HTML are non-editable artifacts. A correction
starts in canonical QMD, then regenerates every affected representation through
the qualified toolchain. UP-D3 owns that toolchain; UP-D8 owns artifact review
and publication evidence.

## Evidence Classes

Every calculation and claim must be classified as observed, derived,
model-scenario, external, provisional, unavailable, or approved within an
explicit scope. Model results are not human measurements. A citation does not
qualify code, and a passing render does not qualify a calculation.

## Approval and Failure Semantics

The default is deny-until-approved. Missing inventory coverage, source
authority, units, coordinate or time convention, implementation symbol, test,
validity range, uncertainty, artifact digest, page review, or human approval
keeps the affected item blocked. Unsupported values are never replaced with
synthetic or plausible values without an explicit model-scenario contract.

## Exemptions

Future freshness exemptions must be structured, narrowly scoped, justified,
owned, reviewed, and expiring. An exemption cannot authorize an equation,
scientific claim, artifact, operating use, or public projection.

## Current Boundary

UP-D0 establishes governance only. The empty calculation registry is honest
evidence that UP-D1 has not completed the inventory. No completeness,
multi-format reproducibility, page inspection, accessibility, or publication
claim is made by this scaffold.
